title: Anthropic IPO is official:  ~$916-1020B valuation, ~ $60B capital raise
gist: Anthropic launched its IPO roadshow for 825M Class A shares (801.35M primary) at $70-78, listing on Nasdaq as 'ANT', with Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley as bookrunners; the forum title frames this as a ~$60B raise at ~$916-1020B valuation.

insights.claim: Anthropic, PBC launched the roadshow for its IPO of 825,000,000 Class A shares, of which 801,351,354 are primary shares sold by Anthropic and 23,648,646 are sold by existing stockholders.
insights.speaker: Xebec
insights.so_what: Overwhelmingly primary offering means proceeds fund the company rather than insider exits.

insights.claim: Anthropic's IPO price range is $70.00-$78.00 per share, implying roughly $56-62 billion of gross proceeds on the 801 million primary shares before the greenshoe.
insights.speaker: Xebec
insights.so_what: One of the largest IPO raises ever; a major liquidity event for AI equity markets.
insights.quote: The initial public offering price is expected to be between $70.00 and $78.00 per share.

insights.claim: Anthropic expects to grant underwriters a 30-day option for up to 123,750,000 additional Class A shares.
insights.speaker: Xebec

insights.claim: Anthropic applied to list its Class A common stock on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the ticker 'ANT'.
insights.speaker: Xebec
insights.so_what: Nasdaq listing implies likely index inclusion flows over time.

insights.claim: Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley are the prospectus contacts for Anthropic's IPO.
insights.speaker: Xebec
insights.so_what: Lead bank fee and league-table boost.
insights.locator: The proposed offering will be made only

insights.claim: The SemiWiki forum thread frames Anthropic's IPO as a roughly $60 billion capital raise at a ~$916-1,020 billion valuation.
insights.speaker: Xebec
insights.so_what: Near-trillion-dollar valuation sets a public benchmark for frontier AI labs.
